from collections import deque


class ConnectGame:
    def __init__(self, board):
        # Row r has r+1 cells: (r, 0) is the left edge, (r, r) the right edge.
        self.grid = [line.strip().split() for line in board.strip().splitlines() if line.strip()]
        self.rows = len(self.grid)

    def _neighbors(self, r, c):
        yield from [
            (r - 1, c - 1),
            (r - 1, c),
            (r, c - 1),
            (r, c + 1),
            (r + 1, c),
            (r + 1, c + 1),
        ]

    def _reaches(self, player, is_edge, goal):
        start = [
            (r, c)
            for r, row in enumerate(self.grid)
            for c in range(len(row))
            if row[c] == player and is_edge(r, c)
        ]
        seen = set(start)
        queue = deque(start)
        while queue:
            r, c = queue.popleft()
            if goal(r, c):
                return True
            for nr, nc in self._neighbors(r, c):
                if (
                    0 <= nr < self.rows
                    and 0 <= nc < len(self.grid[nr])
                    and self.grid[nr][nc] == player
                    and (nr, nc) not in seen
                ):
                    seen.add((nr, nc))
                    queue.append((nr, nc))
        return False

    def get_winner(self):
        if not self.grid:
            return ""
        if self._reaches("X", lambda r, c: c == 0, lambda r, c: c == r):
            return "X"
        if self._reaches("O", lambda r, c: r == 0, lambda r, c: r == self.rows - 1):
            return "O"
        return ""
